name: ds-lineage-explorer
description: Single-viewport lineage graph of ~110 data structures, built from two research reports. Raw HTML/CSS/JS, no framework, no build step at view time.

comments.toolchain: Versions pinned to the mid-2026 baseline (web_platform_baseline_manifest §7). These tools run in CI, not in the browser — the shipped app has zero runtime dependencies. Node was unavailable in the authoring environment, so `check`/`test` are the committed contract, not a verified run (see README).
